sources.title: Omada SDN Controller User Guide - Configure the Network
facts: controller-managed devices are read-only through NMS

sources.title: Omada SDN Controller User Guide - Monitor the Network
Configuring System Logs
sources.scope: model-scoped standalone-switch guide; never generalized outside cited applicability

notes: Do not generalize standalone-switch logging fields or limits to every Omada-managed model.
Do not assume SNMP write capability for controller-managed devices; the cited controller guide explicitly limits NMS access to read-only.

snmp.v3_identity: username plus authentication/privacy parameters when exposed by exact runtime

monitoring.rule: Monitoring evidence is read-only unless an explicitly authorized configuration change is required.

system_logging.controller_managed_rule: Only apply remote-log fields that are surfaced and source-backed for the exact model/firmware/management mode.

pass_requires: successful read-only SNMP poll from the intended NMS
remote syslog receipt when remote logging is configured and supported

rollback: Restore the exact prior SNMP/logging configuration and receiver set, then verify monitoring and management reachability.
